example.title: Culvert on county road 522 Avenue between 868 and 869 Roads
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Culvert on 522 Ave (Antelope County, Nebraska))

brief: Single corrugated galvanized-steel pipe-arch culvert (about 4 ft span) under a gravel county road, its mitred end projecting from the grassy embankment with no headwall, in a small wooded draw with a barbed-wire fence and a delineator post. Only two photos exist (east and west ends).
